reviews.title: Best buy in a while
reviews.comment: They work really well. Talk about output! Even without a side panel on my tower, it is moving enough air to keep my graphics card cool. My computer also looks much more impressive with how bright the LEDs are.
reviews.author: DLTwitch88

reviews.title: Excellent Value ARGB Fans
reviews.comment: I bought the 6-pack of these ARGB fans for my build in the HYTE Y60 case and they’ve been excellent for the price. The fans were inexpensive but work great. The ARGB lighting is bright and looks really good through the glass panels of the case. Syncing them with my motherboard’s ARGB controller was quick and easy, and the effects work perfectly. Installation was straightforward and they’ve been running smoothly with good airflow. Overall these are a great value if you want affordable ARGB fans for a build.
reviews.author: James Collison

reviews.title: Great looking fans!
reviews.comment: Solid fans for the price!  Performance is great as a case fan but only decent for a radiator.  Only giving it 4 stars because the linking system is very fragile and easy to bend or break the pins making the fan pretty much useless.
reviews.author: Rachel
